description.value: The Cedars Inn is a 45-room eco-friendly hotel and convention center in Gibsons on the Sunshine Coast, situated less than 10 minutes from the Langdale BC Ferry Terminal — a convenient stop for cyclists arriving or departing via ferry. The property features an outdoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and a fitness centre, plus an on-site Japanese-Korean restaurant. It is one of the few hotels in the area with full convention and banquet facilities, and is notably pet-friendly with ample parking for RVs and trailers.
